_comment: Narration lines mirrored from src/book.ts (TITLE_CARD + PAGES[].text/.secondaryText, combined into one clip per page) and the count words for the give countdown (PRD §5/§6). Keep this in sync by hand if book.ts changes — it's a thin data copy, not the source of truth.

narration.zh: 小兔做兔子灯，准备过中秋。
narration.en: Little Rabbit makes a rabbit lantern for the Mooncake Festival.

narration.zh: 小兔点亮兔子灯，真亮呀！
narration.en: Little Rabbit lights the lantern. It's so bright!

narration.zh: 月饼切成四块，小兔要去分享啦！
narration.en: The mooncake is cut into four pieces. Little Rabbit heads out to share them!
On the way, Little Rabbit watches the dragon dance. So lively!

narration.zh: 小兔给婆婆一块月饼。谢谢小兔！还剩三块。
narration.en: Little Rabbit gives Grandma a piece of the mooncake. Thank you! Three left.

narration.zh: 小兔给公公一块月饼。谢谢小兔！还剩两块。
narration.en: Little Rabbit gives Grandpa a piece of the mooncake. Thank you! Two left.

narration.zh: 小兔给小猫一块月饼。谢谢小兔！还剩一块。
narration.en: Little Rabbit gives a piece of the mooncake to Mr. Cat. Thank you! One left.

narration.zh: 小兔带着最后一块月饼回家。
narration.en: Little Rabbit goes home with the last piece of mooncake.

narration.zh: 小兔回到家，和爸爸妈妈分最后一块月饼。一家团圆。
narration.en: Little Rabbit is home — she shares the last piece with Mom and Dad. Together as one family.

narration.zh: 一起看月亮。月亮上有只兔子！
narration.en: Let's look at the moon together. There's a rabbit in the moon!
